seoTitle: Judson ISD Calendar 2026-2027 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Judson ISD Calendar 2026-2027 with first day, holidays, school breaks, early release dates, PDF, ICS download, and key family planning dates.
calendarNotes: Judson ISD starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 12, 2026 and ends on May 27, 2027. The academic calendar lists 170 student days, with the first semester running August 12-December 18 and the second semester running January 6-May 27. Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, Winter Break runs December 21-January 1, and Spring Break runs March 8-12. The calendar also includes staff development days, teacher prep days, early release times, grading periods, flex days, and bad weather make-up dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Judson ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Judson ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 8 through Friday, March 12, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Judson ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the Judson ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The Judson ISD 2026-2027 academic calendar lists 170 student days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Judson ISD Winter Break in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Judson ISD have bad weather make-up days in 2026-2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar marks October 9, 2026, February 8, 2027, and April 2, 2027 as bad weather make-up dates.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Judson ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Judson ISD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Judson ISD have school on Friday?
calendarFaqs.a: Friday schedules depend on the date. The 2026-2027 Judson ISD calendar includes some Friday student holidays, early release dates, and conditional bad weather make-up dates, so families should check the date table and official Judson ISD announcements for same-week updates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Judson ISD release early?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists early release times by school level. Elementary schools release at 11:30 a.m., middle schools release at 12:15 p.m., and high schools release at 1:00 p.m. on listed early release dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I download a printable Judson ISD calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link on this page to view or print the Judson ISD 2026-2027 academic calendar. The PDF remains the official district source for districtwide dates.

customSections.label: Judson ISD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content:
The Judson ISD school calendar for 2026-2027 provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student and staff holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, bad weather make-up dates, early release times, grading periods, and the last day of school.

This page summarizes the official academic calendar into key dates, downloadable calendar files, and a printable PDF source. Families should still verify campus-specific events, testing windows, Judson Early College Academy dates, athletics, graduation details, and emergency updates through Judson ISD.

customSections.label: Family Planning Guide for Judson ISD 2026-2027
customSections.content: Judson ISD families often use the academic calendar to coordinate childcare, travel, work schedules, and school transitions. The official calendar is especially important because staff development days, teacher prep days, flex days, bad weather make-up days, and early release schedules can affect regular transportation and childcare routines.

groups.label: Childcare planning
items: Plan coverage for staff development and teacher prep days because students are not in school on those dates.
Treat October 9, February 8, and April 2 as conditional bad weather make-up dates until Judson ISD confirms whether they will be used.
Check early release procedures by campus because elementary, middle, and high school release times differ.

groups.label: Travel planning
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 23-27, 2026 and is the clearest full-week fall travel window.
Winter Break runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027, with students returning after early January staff planning dates.
Spring Break runs March 8-12, 2027 and is the main spring travel window for districtwide student planning.

groups.label: School transition planning
items: Use August 12, 2026 to prepare transportation routines, supplies, and before-school or after-school care.
Review grading period dates before scheduling appointments near October 8, December 18, March 19, and May 27.
Families at Judson Early College Academy should check the separate JECA calendar before relying on traditional calendar dates.

customSections.label: How We Verify Judson ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Judson ISD calendars page and published academic calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, grading periods, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, early release details, flex days, bad weather make-up dates, and alternate-calendar links, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Judson ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
